page_title: HAV 0-4 LYO | Le Havre v Lyon 20/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+4' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lyon are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Abdelatif Kherradji interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre).
87' 0 - 4 Goal! Said Benrahma (Lyon) latches on to an accurate pass and quickly strikes a low effort inside the right post.
86' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Le Havre.
86' Here comes a substitution. Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) is brought on as a substitute for Clinton Mata.
86' The current number of shots on goal is 1:7.
83' Pierre Sage has decided to substitute Corentin Tolisso and he is replaced by Warmed Omari (Lyon).

82' Le Havre slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
81' Substitution. Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) has come on for Abdoulaye Toure.
80' The substitution is prepared. Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Josue Casimir.
78' The game has begun to heat up. Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
76' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul.
75' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
73' The substitution has been made. Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) has replaced Malick Fofana.
72' Here is a change. Alexandre Lacazette is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Said Benrahma (Lyon).
72' Substitution. Rayan Cherki makes way for Georges Mikautadze (Lyon).
71' 0 - 3 Rayan Cherki feeds the ball through to Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:3!
66' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Timothee Pembele is replaced by Andre Ayew (Le Havre).
66' Didier Digard has decided to make a change. Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) replaces Rassoul Ndiaye.
65' Substitution. Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) on for Issa Soumare.
63' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
60' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom right corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Lucas Perri. What a save!
57' 0 - 2 Malick Fofana (Lyon) beats the offside trap and bears down on goal. With just the keeper to beat he coolly shoots past him from the edge of the box.
56' Lyon show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
54' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is able to continue to play.
53' A cross from a corner kick by Le Havre is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
53' Loic Nego (Le Havre) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
52' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
51' Loic Nego (Le Havre) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
51' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) takes the corner but it's cleared.
51' Loic Nego (Le Havre) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
50' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
50' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
47' Abdelatif Kherradji shows a yellow card to Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) for his blatant foul.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Malick Fofana (Lyon) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
45+3' Loic Nego (Le Havre) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
42' A quickly taken corner by Lyon.
41' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
40' Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Abdelatif Kherradji saw the whole situation.
36' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
36' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
35' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Abdelatif Kherradji had an easy-decision to make.
35' The resulting corner, taken by Rayan Cherki (Lyon), comes to nothing.
34' Malick Fofana (Lyon) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

32' 0 - 1 Abner (Lyon) has reason to celebrate! His first-time shot from the edge of the area goes low into the middle of the net and past the goalkeeper. Some might blame the keeper for that, but it's hard to say whether he should have saved it. 0:1.
30' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Loic Nego (Le Havre) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
29' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
23' Wonderful movement by Lyon. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
22' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
20' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
18' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) was quite harsh and Abdelatif Kherradji didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
17' A dangerous looking corner kick from Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is cleared to safety by the defence.
17' A short through ball almost allows Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Lyon.
14' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
9' Lyon are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
8' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Arthur Desmas is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
6' Loic Nego (Le Havre) has tested the patience of referee Abdelatif Kherradji and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
6' Arthur Desmas leaps to intercept the corner kick from Rayan Cherki (Lyon).
4' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner which is cleared.
4' The ball breaks to Malick Fofana (Lyon) after a scramble in the box, but his first-time effort is immediately blocked.
3' Le Havre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Lyon will kick the game off.
Abdelatif Kherradji will supervise the game today.
